title: Find the name of the non-fundraiser event with the highest attendance where
question: Find the name of the non-fundraiser event with the highest attendance where at least one attendee incurred an expense over $75, and the event was budgeted for 'Advertisement'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT e.XCL_011
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
WHERE e.XCL_013 <> 'Fundraiser'
  AND b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM attendance AS a2
    JOIN expense AS ex ON a2.XCL_002 = ex.XCL_022
    WHERE a2.XCL_001 = e.XCL_010
      AND ex.XCL_020 > 75
  )
GROUP BY e.XCL_010, e.XCL_011
ORDER BY COUNT(a.XCL_001) DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.XCL_010 = a.XCL_001
JOIN budget AS b ON e.XCL_010 = b.XCL_009
WHERE e.XCL_013 <> 'Fundraiser'

  )
GROUP BY e.XCL_010, e.XCL_011
ORDER BY COUNT(a.XCL_001) DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T2."XCL_011"
FROM event AS T2
INNER JOIN attendance AS T3 ON T2."XCL_010" = T3."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN budget AS T1 ON T2."XCL_010" = T1."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN expense AS T4 ON T1."XCL_003" = T4."XCL_023"
WHERE T1."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
  AND T2."XCL_013" != 'Fundraiser'
  AND T4."XCL_020" > 75
ORDER BY T3."XCL_002" DESC
LIMIT 1
